mechanism: Bi-level experience learning: GitHub Issues/PRs plus summarised experience stored from the agent's own past tasks
evidence_scope: Apart from in-task knowledge learned from community experiences and solutions, OpenAgent can also learn from its own past experiences to improve decision-making over time.
evidence_role: We propose OpenAgent, a novel LLM agent system that autonomously extends its tool set by integrating repositories from GitHub. It employs a hierarchical structure and possesses a bi-level experience learning mechanism.
